apiDocs.title: API & MCP reference
apiDocs.subtitle: Integrate Coworkee with your own tools or an AI agent using a personal API token.
apiDocs.tokenHelp: Create a personal API token on your account page, then send it as an "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header. Every request is scoped to your role (ADMIN / HR / MANAGER / EMPLOYEE).
apiDocs.rbacNote: Tokens never grant more than your role allows — the same permission checks as the app apply to every call.
apiDocs.mcpHelp: Point an MCP client (e.g. Claude) at the endpoint below. Only the tools your role may use are exposed; write and approval tools require the matching permission.
apiDocs.restHelp: All endpoints are under the base URL and require the Bearer token.

meta.title: Coworkee — The HR platform for your whole team
meta.description: Employee management, absences, time tracking, documents, performance, and recruiting in one platform.

hero.title: The HR platform for your whole team.

how.heading: How it works
how.subheading: From zero to up and running — faster than you'd think.

install.title: Install
install.body: One docker compose up on your server, VPS, or Proxmox — or a single install command. Done in minutes.

setup.title: Set up
setup.body: The setup wizard walks you through the admin account, company name, and language on first run. No config chaos.

launch.title: Get going
launch.body: Add your team, enable the modules you need, done. Your people log in and start working right away.

why.heading: Why Coworkee?
why.subheading: A modern HR system that's truly yours — no compromises on privacy or usability.

allInOne.title: Everything in one place
allInOne.body: Nine HR modules in one platform — people, absence, time, documents, performance, recruiting, and more. No tool sprawl, no data silos, one login.

gdpr.title: GDPR & self-hosted
gdpr.body: Your data stays on your infrastructure. Full control, no third parties.

bilingual.title: German & English
bilingual.body: Fully bilingual, switchable anytime — per person, no restart.

open.title: Open & extensible
open.body: Open source and transparent. Customize, extend, run it yourself — no black box.

modern.title: Modern & fast
modern.body: A clean UI, light and dark mode, noticeably fast on every device.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Everything you want to know before you start.

selfHost.a: Yes. Coworkee is open source and runs anywhere Docker runs — VPS, Proxmox/PVE, or bare metal. A single docker compose up is enough, and your data stays with you.

cost.a: Self-hosted, Coworkee is free with no license fees. For managed hosting with operations, updates, and support, just reach out by email.

gdpr.a: Because you self-host, all HR data lives on your own infrastructure — nothing is sent to third parties. With managed hosting we host in the EU.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain?
domain.a: Yes. Self-hosted, you point your domain freely; with managed hosting we connect your preferred domain including HTTPS for you.

managed.a: Yes. We run Coworkee for you — including updates, backups, and personal support. Email us at info@coworkee.de.

modules.subheading: Over twenty modules, one platform. No more piecing things together from tools that don't talk to each other.
